narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the log file.
finalText:
**Redis died and took the whole service down.**

`10.0.0.12:6379` refused all connections at 02:14:07. Every later error follows from that. 520 of 719 lines are three repeating templates.

| time | event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:03 | last `200` served |
| 02:14:07 | [`redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`](logs/app.log:182) |
| 02:14:08 | cache miss storm, direct store reads |
| 02:15:26 | 13 reconnect attempts, all fail, flat 80s apart |
| 02:29:12 | queue depth `502`, over max `500` |
| 02:31:44 | [`JavaScript heap out of memory (request backlog)`](logs/app.log:717) |
| 02:31:52 | [`api unresponsive, killing process group — service down`](logs/app.log:719) |

Service was fully down 17m45s. Retries never backed off or shed load. Cache hit ratio was `0.98` seconds before. Redis died abruptly.

Next: find why Redis at `10.0.0.12` refused connections.
